prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and saved desktop preferences."]
1: ["Calibrate Companion Traits", "Adjust your pet's desktop activity levels and behavioral style before completing adoption."]
2: ["Your pet asset is generating in the background. You can minimize this window at any time."]
3: ["Master Desktop Pet Gestures", "Try out dragging, right-clicking for commands, and using system tray shortcuts before entering your desktop."]
4: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate"]
5: ["Your pet memory and customized traits are safely synced to cloud storage."]
6: ["System Tray & Quick Controls", "Use the tray menu icon anytime to hide your pet, tweak sound effects, or trigger desktop interactions."]
7: ["We'll send a system tray notification as soon as your companion is ready on your desktop."]
8: ["Select between instant ready-to-play companions or generate a custom pet from your photo upload."]
9: ["Select Your Starting Desktop Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting a user photo upload
